reasoning.step1:
1) Document classification
- Presence of explicit invoice indicators: title "Rechnung", "Nummer", "Datum", line items, totals ("Gesamtbetrag", "Netto", "Brutto", "Zahlbetrag"), VAT lines → qualifies as invoice.
- No exclusion headers ("Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung", "Servicebericht") present → not excluded.

2) Identify candidate fields and locations in text
- Invoice.Date: "Datum 26.01.2024" (top right) — clear, unambiguous.
- GrandTotal.Amount: "Zahlbetrag 64,41 EUR" — indicates amount due after skonto; main payable amount shown as 64,41 EUR.
  - Alternative: "Gesamtbetrag Brutto 67,09 EUR" is gross total before skonto; but "Zahlbetrag" is final payable. Choose Zahlbetrag per label.
- Net.Amount: "Gesamtbetrag Netto 55,91 EUR" — clear net total.
- Vat.Amount: "R2  -  20,00%       USt    auf   55,91 ... 11,18 EUR" — VAT amount shown as 11,18 EUR.
- Vat.Rate: "20,00%" appears associated with R2 VAT group; per rules extract rate without percent and keep decimals -> 20.00.
- Sender.VatId: Two VAT IDs appear:
  - "Ihre Ust-Id-Nr. ATU64131246" — this is labeled "Ihre" (your/customer VAT ID), so it's the recipient's VAT ID, not sender.
  - Bottom footer: "Ust.-ID-Nr.     ATU69710958" (in company footer) — this corresponds to CREATON (issuer). Therefore Sender.VatId = ATU69710958.
  - Alternative would be ATU64131246 if misinterpreting "Ihre", but header wording indicates it is customer's VAT ID so choose ATU69710958.

3) Conformity with rules
- No inference beyond visible text; all selected values explicitly present.
- VAT rate returned without "%" and preserving decimals ("20.00").
- Decimal separators converted to dot for numeric JSON fields; number of decimals maintained (e.g., 55,91 -> 55.91; 11,18 -> 11.18; 64,41 -> 64.41).
- Ensure fields present per schema.

4) Final mapping (values identified)
- Invoice.Date -> "26.01.2024"
- GrandTotal.Amount -> 64.41
- Net.Amount -> 55.91
- Vat.Amount -> 11.18
- Vat.Rate -> 20.00
- Sender.VatId -> "ATU69710958"

Vat.Rate — High confidence (≈95%): VAT group shows "20.00%"; per rules extract as numeric 20.00.

Sender.VatId — Medium-high confidence (≈85%): Footer shows "Ust.-ID-Nr. ATU69710958" (company footer); header also shows "Ihre Ust-Id-Nr. ATU64131246" (likely recipient). Chosen value is the footer VAT ID as sender, but interpretation depends on header labeling.
